title: Efficient Knowledge Transfer in Federated Bayesian Optimization through Neural Network Surrogates
abstract: arXiv:2611.15707v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated Bayesian Optimization (FedBO) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing Bayesian Optimization (BO) in distributed, privacy-sensitive settings, enabling agents to accelerate the optimization of their local objectives by sharing knowledge about their similarities without exposing raw data. However, existing methods rely on restrictive assumptions, such as near-identical objective functions or shared Gaussian process hyperparameters that are often violated in heterogeneous real-world applications. We present GLOBAFED, a novel framework that enables efficient knowledge transfer across different but related objectives without compromising privacy. At its core is a probabilistic neural network surrogate with a shared feature-extracting backbone and agent-specific heads equipped with varia- tional Bayesian last layers to provide uncertainty estimates. translated_title: 基于神经网络代理模型的联邦贝叶斯优化中的高效知识迁移
translated_abstract: 联邦贝叶斯优化已成为在分布式、隐私敏感的环境中增强贝叶斯优化的一种强大范式，它使智能体能够通过共享有关彼此相似性的知识来加速本地目标的优化，而无需暴露原始数据。然而，现有方法依赖于限制性假设，例如近乎相同的目标函数或共享的高斯过程超参数，这些假设在异构的现实应用中经常被违反。我们提出了GLOBAFED，这是一个新颖的框架，能够在不损害隐私的前提下，在不同但相关的目标之间实现高效的知识迁移。其核心是一个概率神经网络代理模型，它具有共享的特征提取主干和智能体特定的头部，并配备了变分贝叶斯最后一层以提供不确定性估计。在优化过程中，智能体对共享主干使用联邦学习……
tldr: 提出GLOBAFED框架，通过共享特征提取主干和变分贝叶斯最后一层的概率神经网络代理模型，在联邦贝叶斯优化中实现对不同但相关目标的隐私保护高效知识迁移。
